# Framer

> Framer is a no-code website builder for designers that combines AI, CMS, and collaboration features with powerful developer extensibility through React, plugins, and APIs.

Framer enables both designers and developers to create professional websites without coding, while offering advanced customization through React components, plugin development, and server-side APIs. The platform supports enterprise deployments with security compliance (SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001) and includes a marketplace for community plugins.

## Key Topics

- React Code Components
- Framer Plugins
- Server API
- CMS
- Plugin API
- Canvas
- REST API
- TypeScript
- Cloudflare Workers
- No-Code Website Builder
- Code Overrides
- Property Controls
- Component Sharing
- Website Hosting
- Enterprise Security
